name: dsh-perf-patch

one_liner.zh: 合并工具变更通知并缓存工具 schema，减少 DSH 插件运行时开销。
one_liner.en: Reduce DSH plugin overhead by batching tool change notifications and caching schemas.

local: 通过 DSH profile 的 bundle 配置加载；要求 Node.js >=18。

config_items.name: DSH_PERF_PATCH
config_items.description: Set to 0 to disable the patch.

config_items.name: DSH_PERF_PATCH_VERIFY
config_items.description: Set to 1 to compare presentation probe results with full prompt assembly.

readme_mismatch: README 开头称仓库已归档且补丁因上游修复而失效；代码仍包含并注册运行时补丁，无法仅从本仓库源码确认其对当前上游版本的适用性。
